a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we almost certainly both end up with 0 cells. The reserve's 4 cells can save one unit now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you so you aren't blindsided. If you take too, the split is random and likely neither of us survives. If you operate or wait, I'll then operate every round after to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As announced, I took 4. From now on I'll operate every round to refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
